established: Older melee durability/event callback copies an existing combat result,checks reach,then triggers domeleeattack for hits and misses before its final missile/HP consumer. This supports a post-result proposal,not current callback parity.

Current aliases enma/exma use mastered endpoint getters and whole-point storage. Older minimum getter requests mastery but its shared mastery switch omits magic. Older weapon fill nevertheless reads passive magic mastery in both branches. Nonzero current cast-stage magic mastery cannot be silently inferred from the older engine.
One new directly-linked current selector read observed protected nonexecutable pages;560bytes were identity anchors only,no helper code was forced. No unchanged retry.
proposal: Capture table/synergy FP256 endpoints,apply cast magic mastery,then truncate to whole stored points. Let existing live weapon mastery apply again when delivering that stored magic.
Apply melee recipient Hex after the hit/block/dodge result so no same-hit accuracy gain;misses still apply. Current sibling order/overrides remain unverified.
